sourceName: Tweede Kamer Open Data Portaal / Gegevensmagazijn OData v4 API (verbatim reports produced by VLOS 2.0)
protocol: OData v4 (JSON responses, OData-Version: 4.0 header confirmed) for metadata rows; plain HTTP GET returning text/xml for the actual transcript payload. No auth handshake, no token host. Docs live on opendata.tweedekamer.nl (HTML only — not needed at runtime, allowlist optional).
auth: none. Fully open, anonymous. Verified: a bare `curl` with no headers, no key, no cookie against https://gegevensmagazijn.tweedekamer.nl/OData/v4/2.0/Verslag?$top=1 returned HTTP 200. No registration exists or is required. Official docs page (/documentatie/odata-api) mentions no authentication, API keys, or tokens.
searchEndpoint: Two-step, mandatory. STEP 1 (discover/enumerate meetings + reports): GET /OData/v4/2.0/Verslag with $filter/$expand=Vergadering — returns metadata rows ONLY (no speech text). STEP 2 (get the actual spoken words): GET /OData/v4/2.0/Verslag/{Id}/resource — returns the whole meeting's VLOS 2.0 XML transcript as a single 0.9–3 MB blob. There is NO endpoint that searches or returns individual speech rows.
verificationNote: Executed live via curl on 2026-08-03; nothing was blocked by the sandbox. (1) $metadata → HTTP 200, 57755 bytes, 38 EntityTypes under namespace TK.DA.GGM.OData; confirmed exact property names on Verslag (Id, Soort, Status, ContentType, ContentLength, GewijzigdOp, ApiGewijzigdOp, Verwijderd, Vergadering_Id), Vergadering (Titel, Zaal, Vergaderjaar, VergaderingNummer, Datum, Aanvangstijd, Sluiting, Kamer), Activiteit, ActiviteitActor, Persoon, Fractie. (2) The exampleRequest above → HTTP 200, "@odata.count": 50, first row Id=4807aa73-3938-4c37-90da-8c1891e39169, Soort="Eindpublicatie", Status="Gecorrigeerd", Vergadering.Titel="78e vergadering, donderdag 4 juni 2026", Vergaderjaar="2025-2026", VergaderingNummer=78, Kamer="Tweede Kamer", ContentLength=942077. (3) GET /OData/v4/2.0/Verslag/4807aa73-.../resource → HTTP 200, Content-Type text/xml, 942077 bytes, root element <vlosCoreDocument Source="VLOS2.0" soort="Eindpublicatie" status="Gecorrigeerd" versie="1.3" xmlns="http://www.tweedekamer.nl/ggm/vergaderverslag/v1.0">, containing 245 <woordvoerder>, 345 <interrumpant>, 838 <spreker> elements. (4) Real observed speech unit: <woordvoerder><spreker soort="Tweede Kamerlid"><fractie>VVD</fractie><aanhef>De heer</aanhef><verslagnaam>Van Campen</verslagnaam><weergavenaam>Campen van</weergavenaam><voornaam>Thom</voornaam><achternaam>Campen van</achternaam><functie>lid Tweede Kamer</functie></spreker><markeertijdbegin>2026-07-02T10:15:09</markeertijdbegin><isvoorzitter>true</isvoorzitter><tekst><alinea><alineaitem>Ik open de vergadering van donderdag 2 juli 2026.</alineaitem></alinea></tekst></woordvoerder>. (5) CONFIRMED $search IS SILENTLY IGNORED: /Activiteit/$count returned 99117; /Activiteit/$count?$search=klimaat returned 99117; /Activiteit/$count?$search=zzzznonsensexyz ALSO returned 99117 — identical, no error, no filtering. (6) contains() works: /Activiteit/$count?$filter=contains(Onderwerp,'klimaat') → 833, and 'Klimaat' → 833 (case-insensitive). substringof() → HTTP 400 "unknown function". (7) Pagination: $top=250 → 200 with 250 rows; $top=251 and $top=5000 → HTTP 400 "The limit of '250' for Top query has been exceeded"; request with no $top → 250 rows plus "@odata.nextLink": ".../Vergadering?$skiptoken=Id-e18c70d3-b159-4dd6-a4dd-08b1fc0383fa"; $skip=250 works. (8) Volume: 23263 non-deleted Verslag rows, of which only 1458 are Soort='Eindpublicatie'; 1394 Vergadering rows with Soort='Plenair'. Earliest Vergadering = 2013-06-25 ("99e vergadering, dinsdag 25 juni 2013"). (9) DEDUP HAZARD CONFIRMED: Vergadering_Id 67d1ec85-98ce-4da0-adfc-462cdf5963fd has 10 non-deleted Verslag rows, all ('Tussenpublicatie','Ongecorrigeerd'), ContentLength growing 2242856 → 3028259 as the sitting progressed. (10) ID-JOIN BREAKAGE CONFIRMED: every objectid harvested from the XML 404s against OData — Persoon(eb0e02d7-1747-4ad4-9646-d75f6a82f58d) → 404, and 5 more spreker objectids → 404; Activiteit(8958c8f8-...) and 4 more activiteit objectids → 404; Vergadering(65fe4eec-...) (the vergadering/@objectid inside the XML) → 404 even though the containing Verslag's Vergadering_Id 67d1ec85-... resolves fine. (11) WORKING join key found: XML <parlisid>2026A05269</parlisid> → /Activiteit?$filter=Nummer eq '2026A05269' → HTTP 200, Id=61d086d2-d795-44e5-b149-9c40ecfb893c, Soort="Hamerstukken". (12) Lambda filters work: /Activiteit?$filter=ActiviteitActor/any(a:a/ActorFractie eq 'GroenLinks') → @odata.count 14854. (13) No throttling observed: 8 rapid sequential requests all returned 200; response headers carry no X-RateLimit-*/Retry-After (headers seen: OData-Version, api-supported-versions: "2.0, 3.0", Content-Security-Policy, Set-Cookie TS01b46c01). (14) /OData/v4/3.0/$metadata → HTTP 404 despite api-supported-versions advertising 3.0. (15) /Verslag({id})/$value → HTTP 404 (must use /resource; both Verslag({id})/resource and Verslag/{id}/resource forms return 200). (16) Docs cross-checked on opendata.tweedekamer.nl/documentatie/odata-api and /documentatie/verslag: service root "https://gegevensmagazijn.tweedekamer.nl/OData/v4/2.0", 250-result cap documented, /resource documented, Soort enum {Eindpublicatie, Tussenpublicatie, Voorpublicatie}, Status enum {Casco, Gecorrigeerd, Gerectificeerd, Ongecorrigeerd}, VLOS source system start date 25-06-2013.

queryParams.param: (NONE — no free-text search over speech text exists)
queryParams.note: CRITICAL: there is NO parameter that searches what members actually said. $search is accepted with HTTP 200 but SILENTLY IGNORED (proved: $count identical at 99117 with $search=klimaat, with $search=zzzznonsensexyz, and with no $search). $filter=contains(...) works but ONLY against metadata string columns (Activiteit/Onderwerp, Vergadering/Titel) — i.e. agenda-item subject lines, never the transcript body. Free-text over spoken words requires downloading the VLOS XML per meeting and indexing it in our own store.

Best available server-side text approximation, on Activiteit only. Verified: contains(Onderwerp,'klimaat') → 833 hits; case-INsensitive ('Klimaat' also 833). Also supports startswith()/endswith(). substringof() is NOT supported (HTTP 400). Use this only for topic pre-filtering, not as speech search.

On Verslag, navigate the to-one relation with '/'. Edm.DateTimeOffset, unquoted literal. Verified in exampleRequest. Direct form on Vergadering itself: $filter=Datum ge 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z. Beware: stored offsets are Europe/Amsterdam (+02:00 in summer, +01:00 in winter), so a Z-anchored boundary can shift a sitting by a day.

Combine with 'and'. Note Vergadering.Datum is date-at-midnight (e.g. 2026-06-04T00:00:00+02:00) while Aanvangstijd/Sluiting carry real times — use 'le <date>T23:59:59' or the next day's midnight to avoid dropping the boundary sitting.

PARTIAL/MISLEADING for speech attribution. ActiviteitActor lists scheduled participants of an Activiteit (Relatie observed: 'Deelnemer'; ActorNaam formatted as initials+surname, e.g. 'J.F. Klaver'; 1374 rows for Klaver), NOT who actually spoke in the transcript. Verified any() lambda syntax works (ActorFractie eq 'GroenLinks' → 14854). Real speaker attribution lives only in the XML at woordvoerder/spreker — filter it client-side after parsing.

Same caveat as speaker. ActorFractie is a denormalized free-text label snapshot ('GroenLinks') that can disagree with the joined Fractie/Afkorting ('GL') on the same row — observed both on one record. In the XML, party is the plain <fractie> string inside <spreker>.
Edm.String on Vergadering. Observed value: 'Tweede Kamer'. NOTE the type trap: Vergadering.Kamer is Edm.String but Document.Kamer is Edm.Int32 — do not reuse the literal across entities.
Parliamentary session year as a quoted string, hyphenated, e.g. '2025-2026'. Also present on Activiteit. This is our 'term' field.

$skip=<n> verified working ($skip=250 returned the expected next rows). For deep paging prefer following the server-issued @odata.nextLink, which uses $skiptoken=Id-<guid> (keyset paging, observed literally). Do not hand-craft $skiptoken.

HARD CAP 250, enforced server-side. $top=250 → 200 OK/250 rows; $top=251 → HTTP 400 'The limit of 250 for Top query has been exceeded'. Same 250 cap applies inside $expand per the docs. Omitting $top also yields 250 + nextLink.

$expand=Vergadering verified (nested options in parens, separated by ';', e.g. $expand=Vergadering($select=Titel,Datum)). $orderby=Vergadering/Datum desc verified across the navigation. $count=true adds '@odata.count'; on the /$count path segment $top and $skip are ignored. $format=none recommended by docs in production to shrink payloads. ALWAYS add 'Verwijderd eq false' — deleted records persist as placeholders.

pagination: Two mechanisms, both verified. (a) Offset: $top (max 250, hard 400 error above that) + $skip=<n>. (b) Server-driven keyset: omit $top (or exhaust a page) and the response carries "@odata.nextLink": "https://gegevensmagazijn.tweedekamer.nl/OData/v4/2.0/Vergadering?$skiptoken=Id-e18c70d3-b159-4dd6-a4dd-08b1fc0383fa" — follow it verbatim until absent. Total via $count=true → "@odata.count" (observed 50 on the example query, 23263 for all non-deleted Verslag). Recommended for our ingester: use nextLink/$skiptoken, because deep $skip over 23k rows is both slow and unstable under concurrent writes. Note the transcript payload itself is NOT paginated — /resource is one atomic 0.9–3 MB XML download, so Lambda memory and the 15-min timeout are the real constraints, not paging.

fieldMapping.note: Prefer the per-activiteit title so each speech gets its real debate topic. Observed activiteit titles: 'Opening', 'Mededelingen', 'Hamerstukken'. The OData-level Vergadering.Titel is only a sitting label — observed '78e vergadering, donderdag 4 juni 2026' — usable as a coarse fallback but it is not a subject.

verslagnaam is the clean Hansard-style rendering — observed 'Van Campen'. Sibling fields observed on the same <spreker>: voornaam='Thom', achternaam='Campen van' (surname is INVERTED/normalized, not display order), weergavenaam='Campen van', aanhef='De heer', functie='lid Tweede Kamer', and attribute soort='Tweede Kamerlid'. Use verslagnaam for display; build full name from voornaam + a de-inverted achternaam. Interjections are nested <interrumpant> INSIDE a <woordvoerder> — you must emit them as separate speech rows or you will attribute the interrupter's words to the floor holder (verified: 345 interrumpant vs 245 woordvoerder in one Eindpublicatie).

Plain string, observed 'VVD', 'SGP', 'GroenLinks'. Historical label as-of the sitting, so it is correct point-in-time and should NOT be overwritten from current Persoon.Fractielabel. Empty/absent for non-member speakers (ministers, Chair acting ex officio). OData alternative ActiviteitActor.ActorFractie is scheduling metadata, not speech-level, and was observed disagreeing with the joined Fractie.Afkorting ('GroenLinks' vs 'GL').

fieldMapping.sourcePath: OData: Verslag.Vergadering.Datum; precise per-speech time from XML woordvoerder/markeertijdbegin
fieldMapping.note: Vergadering.Datum observed '2026-06-04T00:00:00+02:00' — date at local midnight, use for the sitting date. markeertijdbegin observed '2026-07-02T10:15:09' — LOCAL, NO offset suffix, so you must attach Europe/Amsterdam explicitly before converting to UTC or every timestamp lands 1–2 h off. markeertijdeind gives duration.

Both observed literally 'Tweede Kamer'. Also carried on the XML vergadering element as attribute kamer="Tweede Kamer". Map to our constant chamber='Tweede Kamer' / 'lower'. Use Vergadering.Soort ('Plenair' vs 'Commissie') to distinguish floor debates from committee sittings — this is the field that actually matters for scope.
Observed '2025-2026' in both. Dutch parliamentary year runs Sept→Sept, so it does NOT equal a calendar year and must be stored verbatim, not derived from date.

Compose the sitting reference as e.g. '2025-2026/78' (observed VergaderingNummer=78, Vergaderjaar='2025-2026'; XML equivalents vergaderingnummer/vergaderjaar). For the finer-grained agenda-item reference use XML activiteit/parlisid — observed '2026A05269', '2026Z03566' — which is the ONLY verified working join back into OData: /Activiteit?$filter=Nummer eq '2026A05269' returned Id=61d086d2-d795-44e5-b149-9c40ecfb893c. Note parlisid is sometimes an empty element (<parlisid />).

The actual spoken words. tekst → 1..n <alinea> → 1..n <alineaitem>; join alineaitem with spaces and alinea with newlines. Inline <nadruk type="Vet"> must be stripped to text. Gotcha: the first alineaitem is usually a redundant speaker prefix ('De <nadruk>voorzitter</nadruk>:') that should be dropped to avoid polluting embeddings. Procedural narration also appears in <draadboekfragment> (258 in one report) which has tekst but NO spreker — decide explicitly whether to index those as unattributed.

UNVERIFIED for a human-facing deep link — no citizen-readable per-debate URL was confirmed. I probed three plausible www.tweedekamer.nl patterns and ALL returned 404: /kamerstukken/plenaire_verslagen/detail/2026-2026/90, /debat_en_vergadering/plenaire_vergaderingen/details?id={guid}, /kamerstukken/verslagen/detail?id={guid}. Only the section index https://www.tweedekamer.nl/debat_en_vergadering/plenaire_vergaderingen returned 200. Ship the API /resource URL as a stable machine-resolvable citation; to give users a readable page we would need to either scrape the plenaire_vergaderingen index to learn the real slug scheme, or cite the KOOP Handelingen record via zoek.officielebekendmakingen.nl (also unverified — my probe of its /resultaten search returned HTTP 400).

fieldMapping.sourcePath: OData: Verslag.Id (+ XML woordvoerder/@objectid for the speech-level id)
fieldMapping.note: Verslag.Id is an Edm.Guid, observed '4807aa73-3938-4c37-90da-8c1891e39169', and is the correct document-level primary key. For per-speech ids use woordvoerder/@objectid (observed '9aaa2fe1-7707-4924-b582-67aae8b99833') or interrumpant/@objectid — but treat these as XML-LOCAL ONLY: they are NOT resolvable OData keys (see gotchas). Recommended stable composite: {Vergadering_Id}:{parlisid}:{woordvoerder objectid}. Do NOT key on Verslag.Id alone, because one sitting yields up to 10 Verslag rows.

No language field anywhere in the OData model or the VLOS XML. All transcript content observed is Dutch. Only Fractie carries a translated attribute (NaamEN) — the debates themselves are nl-only. Frisian-language contributions do occasionally occur in the Tweede Kamer and would be silently tagged 'nl'.

fullTextAccess: Separate endpoint, whole-meeting XML blob — CONFIRMED, and this is the central integration cost. The OData rows for Verslag contain ZERO speech text: the entity has only Id, Soort, Status, ContentType, ContentLength, GewijzigdOp, ApiGewijzigdOp, Verwijderd, Vergadering_Id. To get spoken words you must GET https://gegevensmagazijn.tweedekamer.nl/OData/v4/2.0/Verslag/{Id}/resource which returns Content-Type text/xml, one <vlosCoreDocument Source="VLOS2.0" xmlns="http://www.tweedekamer.nl/ggm/vergaderverslag/v1.0"> per ENTIRE SITTING (observed 942 KB for a corrected final report, 2.24 MB and 3.03 MB for interim ones). Note the entity is NOT declared HasStream in $metadata (zero HasStream entities), and /$value returns 404 — /resource is the only path (both Verslag({id})/resource and Verslag/{id}/resource work). Structure: vlosCoreDocument → vergadering → activiteit(@soort,@objectid) → activiteithoofd → activiteitdeel → activiteititem → woordvoerder(→ spreker, markeertijdbegin/eind, isvoorzitter, isdraad, tekst) with <interrumpant> nested inside woordvoerder for interjections, plus <draadboekfragment> for procedural narration and <stemmingen>/<stemming>/<stem> for votes (out of our scope — filter these out). One report yielded 245 woordvoerder + 345 interrumpant + 838 spreker elements. Practical consequence: we must build a bulk ingest + XML parse + own full-text/vector index. Sizing from live counts: 23263 non-deleted Verslag rows total, of which 1458 are Soort='Eindpublicatie'; ingesting only final plenary reports is roughly 1458 × ~1 MB ≈ 1.5 GB of XML — a one-off backfill job, then incremental via ApiGewijzigdOp or the SyncFeed API (https://gegevensmagazijn.tweedekamer.nl/SyncFeed/2.0/Feed?category=Verslag, root returned HTTP 200). This will not fit a naive synchronous Lambda-per-query design.
languages: Dutch (nl) only. No language field exists in either the OData model or the VLOS XML, so language must be hardcoded. Metadata labels/enums are Dutch too (Soort='Eindpublicatie', Status='Gecorrigeerd', Kamer='Tweede Kamer'), and filter literals must be the Dutch strings. The single English artifact in the whole model is Fractie.NaamEN (party name); there is no English transcript, no translated titles, and no bilingual variant of any endpoint. Frisian may occasionally be spoken and would be indistinguishable from Dutch in the data.
rateLimits: No documented and no observed rate limiting — but treat as UNVERIFIED at scale. Observed: 8 rapid sequential requests all returned HTTP 200 with no 429 and no backoff; response headers contain NO X-RateLimit-*, no Retry-After, no Retry hints (full header set seen: HTTP/1.1 200 OK, Content-Type, OData-Version: 4.0, api-supported-versions: "2.0, 3.0", Content-Security-Policy, Date, Set-Cookie TS01b46c01=..., Transfer-Encoding: chunked). The official /documentatie/odata-api page states no throttling rules; the only load-control mechanism it documents is the 250-result page cap, explicitly justified as "Om de belasting van individuele queries op het Gegevensmagazijn te minimaliseren". The portal's introduction page does reference a disclaimer (https://opendata.tweedekamer.nl/disclaimer) about keeping access open for everyone and ensuring "een stabiele verbinding", which implies fair-use expectations without numeric limits. The Set-Cookie is from a BIG-IP/ASM-style front end (TS-prefixed cookie), which commonly fronts WAF rules that can shed aggressive traffic — so a 1458-file backfill hammering /resource could plausibly trip protections I did not exercise. Recommendation: serial or max 2 concurrent requests, ~200-500 ms delay between calls, exponential backoff on 429/403/503, a descriptive User-Agent with contact info, and run the bulk backfill off-peak; prefer the SyncFeed API for incremental sync rather than repolling OData.
gotchas: DEALBREAKER FOR 'ready': there is NO free-text search over what members said. $search is accepted and returns HTTP 200 but is SILENTLY IGNORED — proven three ways: /Activiteit/$count = 99117, /Activiteit/$count?$search=klimaat = 99117, /Activiteit/$count?$search=zzzznonsensexyz = 99117. A naive implementation would look like it works while returning arbitrary unfiltered rows. Never use $search against this API.

contains() only reaches metadata, never transcripts. contains(Onderwerp,'klimaat') → 833 hits, but Onderwerp is an agenda-item subject line. No OData field anywhere holds speech text, so keyword search over debates MUST be done in our own index after parsing the XML.

Massive Verslag duplication per sitting — dedup is mandatory. Vergadering_Id 67d1ec85-98ce-4da0-adfc-462cdf5963fd has 10 non-deleted Verslag rows, ALL ('Tussenpublicatie','Ongecorrigeerd'), with ContentLength growing 2242856 → 3028259 as the sitting progressed: these are successive live snapshots of the same debate, not distinct documents. Ingesting Verslag naively multiplies every speech ~10x. Select one row per Vergadering_Id: prefer Soort='Eindpublicatie', else the max GewijzigdOp.

Only 1458 of 23263 Verslag rows are Eindpublicatie. If you filter to final corrected reports you get clean text but LOSE recent debates (final versions lag — a 4 June 2026 sitting was only finalized 31 July 2026, ~8 weeks). If you include Tussenpublicatie/Voorpublicatie you get near-live coverage but with Status 'Casco'/'Ongecorrigeerd' text that is incomplete or later revised. Store Soort+Status per record and surface an 'uncorrected' caveat.

EVERY GUID inside the XML is XML-local and 404s against OData. Verified: 6 spreker/@objectid → Persoon(...) all 404; 5 activiteit/@objectid → Activiteit(...) all 404; and vergadering/@objectid=65fe4eec-8e2e-455b-b17b-78d37cc111f8 → Vergadering(...) 404 even though the parent Verslag's Vergadering_Id=67d1ec85-... resolves 200. Do NOT build joins on XML objectids. The only verified bridge is XML <parlisid> → /Activiteit?$filter=Nummer eq '<parlisid>' (2026A05269 → Id 61d086d2-...), and parlisid is sometimes empty (<parlisid />).

Linking a speaker to a Persoon record requires fuzzy name matching, which will misattribute. There is no usable person id in the transcript, and the XML surname is inverted: spreker/achternaam='Campen van', voornaam='Thom'. Persoon stores these split as Achternaam='Campen' + Tussenvoegsel='van' + Roepnaam='Thom'. Verified failure: /Persoon?$filter=Achternaam eq 'Campen van' → 0 rows; Achternaam eq 'Campen' → 1 row (Id bf494e35-c009-4c74-a5c6-3cb2cd26bb51). You must strip/split the tussenvoegsel. Dutch politics also has many same-surname MPs (the attendance list shows 'Martin Bosma', 'Heera Dijk', 'Jimmy Dijk', 'Diederik van Dijk', 'Emiel van Dijk', 'Inge van Dijk'), so surname-only matching is unsafe — disambiguate with the <fractie> label and the sitting date.

Interjections are NESTED, not siblings: <interrumpant> appears INSIDE <woordvoerder>. A naive 'iterate woordvoerder, take tekst' parse attributes the interrupter's words to the floor holder. One Eindpublicatie had 345 interrumpant vs 245 woordvoerder — the majority of speech acts are interjections. Emit them as their own rows with their own spreker.

Timestamps mix two conventions. OData returns explicit offsets (Datum '2026-06-04T00:00:00+02:00'), but XML markeertijdbegin/markeertijdeind and <datum> have NO offset ('2026-07-02T10:15:09') and are Europe/Amsterdam local. Parsing those as UTC shifts every speech 1–2 h and can move it across a date boundary. Likewise a Z-anchored $filter date range can include/exclude the wrong sitting since Datum is local midnight.

$top is hard-capped at 250 and EXCEEDING IT IS A 400, NOT A CLAMP. $top=251 and $top=5000 both → HTTP 400 'The limit of 250 for Top query has been exceeded'. The docs mention the 250 default but do not state that a larger $top errors. Any code that computes a page size from a caller-supplied limit must clamp to 250 or it will hard-fail.

Guess-free filtering only: Soort enums are exact Dutch strings and wrong guesses return an empty set with HTTP 200, not an error. I burned real queries on this — Activiteit Soort 'Plenaire vergadering' → 0 rows and 'Plenair debat' → 0 rows, while Vergadering Soort 'Plenair' → 1394 rows. Silent empty results are the dominant failure mode; assert non-empty in tests.
Always append 'Verwijderd eq false'. Deleted entities are retained as placeholders (documented and modelled on every entity), so unfiltered queries return tombstones with null-ish content.
Type inconsistency across entities: Vergadering.Kamer is Edm.String ('Tweede Kamer') but Document.Kamer is Edm.Int32. Reusing a chamber literal across entities produces a 400.

Advertised API version 3.0 does not exist. Response header says api-supported-versions: '2.0, 3.0', but https://gegevensmagazijn.tweedekamer.nl/OData/v4/3.0/$metadata → HTTP 404. Pin the path to /OData/v4/2.0.

/$value is not supported — Verslag({id})/$value → 404 with application/problem+json. Use /resource. The entity is not declared HasStream, so generic OData client libraries will not offer a media-read helper; issue a plain GET.

Official docs carry a self-declared staleness warning ('Deze documentatie kan nog oude informatie bevatten') because the OData API was updated and attributes renamed. Trust live $metadata over the documentation pages.

No verified human-readable permalink for a debate — three www.tweedekamer.nl URL patterns all 404 (see sourceUrl mapping). Citations will point at raw API URLs unless we invest in resolving the public slug scheme or the KOOP Handelingen record.

Coverage starts 2013-06-25 (earliest Vergadering: '99e vergadering, dinsdag 25 juni 2013'), matching the documented VLOS source-system start date. Transcripts before mid-2013 are NOT in this API — pre-2013 Handelingen would have to come from KOOP/officielebekendmakingen. Committee sittings are also present (Vergadering.Soort='Commissie', e.g. 'Procedurevergadering') and are often Status='Casco' shells, so filter on Soort='Plenair' if we only want floor debates.

The transcript payload is not paginated and not partially fetchable: /resource is atomic, up to ~3 MB of XML per sitting, ~1.5 GB for a full Eindpublicatie backfill. Combined with XML parsing this does not fit a synchronous per-query Lambda; it needs an async ingest job plus stored index, with incremental refresh via ApiGewijzigdOp or SyncFeed (https://gegevensmagazijn.tweedekamer.nl/SyncFeed/2.0/Feed?category=Verslag, returned HTTP 200).
